facts.summary: AstraZeneca discontinued dosing after animal lung toxicity findings · Phase 2a · elarekibep in asthma · not yet approved

evidence.summary: partner AstraZeneca yesterday communicated to the Company its decision to discontinue and cease dosing in the ongoing clinical studies of elarekibep, an inhaled IL-4 receptor alpha inhibitor under development for the treatment of asthma.
evidence.safety: lung findings from a non-clinical 13-week GLP toxicology study with dry powder inhaler-formulated elarekibep, which are not a concern for the active clinical studies
evidence.program_discontinued: its decision to discontinue and cease dosing in the ongoing clinical studies of elarekibep
